data_description.api_password: Leave blank to keep the existing password.

data.enable_notifications: Show UI pop-up notifications during sync
data.include_offline_extensions: Show offline extension entities as unavailable (instead of hiding them)
data.ignored_markers: Marker IDs to exclude from Logikplan connection

data_description.ignored_markers: Comma- or semicolon-separated marker IDs with or without 'M' prefix (e.g. '123, 456; 789' or 'M123, M456; M789'). Only markers with a description can be ignored.

select_action.title: Initial Setup
select_action.description:
The required Web-IO device class(es) are missing on your Comexio server: **{missing_classes}**.

Would you like to create them now?

entity_id_mismatch.title: Duplicate server ID in entity IDs ({server_id})

entity_id_fix.title: Fix Entity IDs
entity_id_fix.description:
**{count} entities** were found with a duplicate server-ID prefix in their entity_id.

The entity IDs can be corrected automatically. **History and automations are preserved**, but please review automations that reference these entity IDs directly.

Would you like to fix the IDs now?

statistics_cleanup.title: Clean Up Statistics
statistics_cleanup.description:
**{count} orphaned long-term statistics** were found that no longer belong to any existing entity (leftovers from previous entity IDs).

They can be safely deleted. **Live sensors and their current history are not affected** — only the orphaned entries are removed.

Would you like to delete them now?

extension_offline.title: Comexio extension module offline ({server_id})
extension_offline.description: Extension module(s) **{extensions}** went offline during operation. This may indicate a hardware failure or connection problem. If the module was intentionally decommissioned, you can dismiss this notification.

ignored_markers_cleanup.title: Cleanup markers marked as ignored ({server_id})
ignored_markers_cleanup.description: The following markers are marked as ignored: {ids}. Their Home Assistant entities, webhooks, and Comexio Web-IO connections can now be removed. Click 'Fix' to proceed with cleanup.

ignored_markers_invalid.title: Invalid ignored markers ({server_id})
ignored_markers_invalid.description: The following marker IDs in the ignored_markers list are invalid or have no description: {ids}. These markers cannot be ignored. Please remove them from the ignored_markers list in the integration options.
